scripts.build: bun run build:section && bun run build:settings && bun run build:service && bun run build:plugin
scripts.build:section: bun build src/section/main.ts --outfile src/section/main.js --target browser --format iife --minify
scripts.build:settings: bun build src/settings/main.ts --outfile src/settings/main.js --target browser --format iife --minify
scripts.build:service: bun build src/service/main.ts --outfile src/service/main.js --target node --format esm
scripts.build:plugin: bun build src/opencode-plugin/index.ts --outfile src/opencode-plugin/index.js --target node --format esm --minify
